about: Voice of every villager personality and of children, read by the game (VoiceTable) and the voice tooling. A personality-specific line renders only in its personality's voice; a shared line (a profession conversation) renders in every adult voice; a child conversation in both child voices. A villager who accepted banmal speaks the ko_banmal text in the same voice.

v_lazy.design: young man, 20s, soft, slow, sleepy-cheerful, slightly nasal, relaxed

v_jock.design: young man, 20s, energetic, loud, bright, fast-ish but clear

v_smug.design: man, 30s, smooth, mellow, confident, slightly theatrical

v_peppy.design: young woman, late teens or 20, high, bubbly, excited

v_snooty.design: woman, 30s, elegant, cool, precise, a little haughty

events.request: hangulquest:line.<requestId>.<personality>_<part>.<voiceId> (requestId starts with req_; part is offer, accept, decline, reminder or thanks)
